The appended amendment and ADR-0046 require an explicit unit/pool binding for AUDITOR merits, but neither names this existing line as superseded or retained for /auditoria and /arquivo. That is a known shared-role conflict T0 will hit.

findings.claim: RAIT.IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY is catalogued only for 'mesma Idempotency-Key com payload diferente' on 'comandos de criação', with context `key`. ADR-0046 extends it to cross-actor reuse on the claim selector with no prior payload, but the catalog amendment does not say this.

Existing pool membership may already be an accepted coordinator scope source, and the ADR leaves that possible overlap to a later amendment.
